component.name: editlicious
component.summary: Calm, keyboard-first text editor for huge files

description.p: editlicious is a calm, keyboard-first text editor that opens and edits huge files – millions of lines, lines with millions of characters, files up to 4 GB. The text lives in a rope inside a Rust engine; the window only renders what you see, vertically and horizontally.

ul.li: Distraction-free: menu bar on Alt, tabs only with a second file, F1 hides everything but the text
Command palette – every function is a command with a shortcut
Several carets, column selection and selections that grow with every double click
Find and replace with regular expressions, marks for every match in the scroll bar
Syntax colours for more than 70 languages, thirteen colour schemes, soft wrap
Encodings and line endings detected on load and kept on save; atomic saving
No telemetry, no accounts, no update pings
